items.originalTitle: Juan Pablo Montoya demands "consequences" for Ferrari drivers after Mexican GP disaster
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver and F1 TV pundit Juan Pablo Montoya has argued that there must be "consequences" for Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after their first-lap battle likely cost Ferrari the win at the Mexican Grand Prix.
detailZh: 胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚在墨西哥大奖赛灾难后要求法拉利车手承担“后果”
胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚呼吁法拉利在刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔于墨西哥首圈发生冲突后对他们施加后果
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更远地方的最新法拉利F1车队新闻、车手动态、技术分析和比赛反应。
前一级方程式车手、F1 TV评论员胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚认为，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔在首圈的争夺很可能让法拉利丢掉了墨西哥大奖赛的胜利，因此必须让他们承担“后果”。
当勒克莱尔试图超越从杆位发车的汉密尔顿时，两位车手都跑宽了。勒克莱尔取得领先，而汉密尔顿被红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘超越，丢掉了一个位置。这位摩纳哥车手因该事件被处以五秒罚时，维斯塔潘最终赢得了比赛。
蒙托亚在天空体育（天空体育）的F1电视赛后节目中发言，敦促法拉利对其车手施加后果。
“必须进行适当的对话，也必须实施处罚，”这位前车手解释道。“他们需要知道自己的行为会带来后果，因为他们今天本应该赢的。”
前印地赛车系列赛车手詹姆斯·欣奇克利夫与蒙托亚一同参与转播，他补充道：“马克斯太不可思议了。红牛执行得非常漂亮。但这不是红牛赢得的比赛，这是法拉利输掉的比赛。如果你看看接下来的赛道，除非出现奇迹，我认为这是他们今年剩余时间里赢得胜利的最佳机会。他们配得上胜利。他们排位赛表现很好，但他们的车手今天让他们失望了。”
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔在事故发生后呼吁他的车手们保持尊重。
“我认为这只是一个尊重的问题，对品牌的尊重，对赞助商的尊重，对车队的尊重，对在家里拼命工作的2000名员工的尊重，我认为我们在性能方面正在回归，我们确实向前迈出了良好的一步，”这位法国人对天空体育F1说。
“两次升级，家里的人们日夜工作。老实说，对我来说，像这样放弃一场胜利很难消化。我会有时间和他们讨论，但老实说，今天我有点低落。”
法拉利现在将展望本周的巴西大奖赛。
detailEn: Juan Pablo Montoya demands "consequences" for Ferrari drivers after Mexican GP disaster
Juan Pablo Montoya has called for Ferrari to impose consequences on Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after their first-lap clash in Mexico
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Former Formula 1 driver and F1 TV pundit Juan Pablo Montoya has argued that there must be "consequences" for Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after their first-lap battle likely cost Ferrari the win at the Mexican Grand Prix.

Both drivers ran wide when Leclerc attempted to overtake Hamilton, who had started from pole position. Leclerc emerged in the lead, while Hamilton lost a position to Red Bull's Max Verstappen. The Monegasque driver was handed a five-second penalty for the incident, and Verstappen ultimately won the race.
Speaking on F1 TV's post-race show, Montoya urged Ferrari to impose consequences on its drivers.

"There have to be proper conversations, and there have to be penalties," the former driver explained. "They need to know there’s going to be consequences for what they’re doing, because they should have won today."

Former IndyCar Series driver James Hinchcliffe, who joined Montoya on the broadcast, added: "Max is incredible. Red Bull executed beautifully. But this was not a race that Red Bull won. This was a race that Ferrari lost. And if you look at the tracks coming up, short of a miracle, I think this was their best chance for the rest of the year to get a win. They deserved it. They qualified well and their drivers let them down today."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur called for respect from his drivers after the incident.

"I think it’s just a matter of respect, the respect for the brand, for the sponsor, for the team, for the 2,000 people working at home like hell that I think we are coming back in terms of performance, that we did a good step forward," the Frenchman told Sky Sports F1.

"With both upgrades, the people at home are working night and day. And honestly, it’s difficult to digest for me to give up a win like this. I will have time to discuss with them, but honestly, today I’m a bit down."
Ferrari will now look ahead to the Brazilian Grand Prix this week.

items.originalTitle: Cadillac to investigate high-speed Mexico GP failure that led to angry Valtteri Bottas reaction
items.summaryEn: Cadillac Formula 1 team principal Marcin Budkowski has vowed to investigate the high-speed failure that ended Valtteri Bottas' Mexico Grand Prix and to ensure such accidents do not happen again.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克将调查导致瓦尔特利·博塔斯愤怒反应的墨西哥大奖赛高速故障
瓦尔特利·博塔斯对此次事故明显感到沮丧，车队领队马尔钦·布德科夫斯基已承诺展开调查
凯迪拉克F1车队领队马尔钦·布德科夫斯基承诺，确保像终结瓦尔特利·博塔斯墨西哥大奖赛那样的事故“不再发生”。
博塔斯在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道第46圈以最高速度进入1号弯时，刹车瞬间左前悬挂断裂，这位芬兰车手随即打滑撞上TecPro护墙。
造成的损坏如此之大，这位前F1分站冠军得主一直留在他的MAC-26赛车中，直到他缓过气来，同时赛会出示红旗暂停了比赛，以便赛道工作人员开始修复护栏。
在随后被发布到社交媒体上的车队无线电中，博塔斯——明显情绪激动——反复爆粗口，随后比赛工程师约翰·霍华德询问他是否没事。“当然不好，”这位曾效力于威廉姆斯、梅赛德斯和阿尔法·罗密欧的车手回答道。
在前往医疗中心检查并获准无碍后，博塔斯被免除了媒体职责。但在凯迪拉克的赛后媒体简报会上，他解释道：“进入1号弯时是一次巨大的撞击，但幸运的是我没事。
“感谢医疗团队为我检查，也感谢所有在现场提供帮助的人。这证明了国际汽联多年来为使我们的运动尽可能安全所付出的辛勤努力。”
“我们需要作为一个团队彻底梳理所有事情，准确弄清发生了什么，并确保从中吸取教训。我们第一圈跑得很强，提升了一些位置，所以没能完成又一场比赛令人失望。我们现在会重新集结，专注于下周在圣保罗继续取得进步。”
博塔斯和队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在凯迪拉克的首个F1赛季中遭遇了多次可靠性故障，不过这些故障的危险性要低得多，两位车手都能要么驶入维修区车库退赛，要么在赛道上停车。
然而，布德科夫斯基在同一次复盘会上指出这一问题的严重性时说：“在第46圈的事故之后，大家都为瓦尔特利安然无恙感到宽慰。我们将全面调查这次故障的原因，并确保此类事故不再发生。”
佩雷斯迎来第300场F1比赛，表现积极
在车库的另一侧，佩雷兹在主场观众面前为车队奉献了一场充满希望的表现，同时迎来了他在F1的第300场分站赛。
这位墨西哥车手在开局阶段凭借实力升至第13位，并成功挡住了身后的对手，然而一次缓慢的进站以及随后因软件问题导致的维修区超速罚单，最终毁掉了原本强劲的表现。
“从积极的角度看，就相对速度而言，这是我们最具竞争力的一周，看到两位车手在车阵中拼搏非常令人鼓舞，”布德科夫斯基坚持说道。
Dan Towriss，凯迪拉克车队，马尔钦·布德科夫斯基，凯迪拉克车队
两人的起步都很棒，尤其是佩雷兹，他在两次起步后的首圈表现极为出色，一度升至第13位。我们在两次进站中都遇到了设备问题，这让两位车手都损失了时间，并在赛道上丢掉了位置。
“祝贺佩雷兹迎来他具有历史意义的第300场大奖赛——对他和整个车队来说，在他的主场比赛中，这是如此难忘的一周。”
detailEn: Cadillac to investigate high-speed Mexico GP failure that led to angry Valtteri Bottas reaction
Valtteri Bottas was audibly frustrated by the incident, which team principal Marcin Budkowski has vowed to investigate
Cadillac Formula 1 team principal Marcin Budkowski has vowed to ensure accidents like the one that ended Valtteri Bottas' Mexico Grand Prix "do not happen again".

Bottas was at top speed entering Turn 1 on lap 46 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rogriguez when his front-left suspension collapsed as he hit the brakes, sending the Finn into a slide and into the TecPro barrier.
Such was the damage caused, the former F1 race winner remained in his MAC-26 while he regained his breath and a red flag was thrown to suspend the race while marshals began repairing the barriers.

In team radio that has since been posted on social media, Bottas - clearly agitated - repeatedly shouts expletives before being asked by race engineer John Howard if he was ok. "F**k no," was the response of the former Williams, Mercedes, and Alfa Romeo driver.

After a trip to the medical centre, where he was given the all-clear, Bottas was excused from media duties. But in Cadillac's post-race media debrief, he explained: “It was a big impact going into Turn 1, but thankfully I’m OK.

"Thank you to the medical team for checking me over and to everyone who helped at the scene. It is a testament to the hard work the FIA has put in over many years to make our sport as safe as possible.

“We need to work through everything thoroughly as a team to understand exactly what happened, and make sure we learn from it. We had a strong opening lap and made up some places, so it’s disappointing not to finish another race. We’ll regroup now and focus on continuing to make progress in Sao Paulo next week.”

Bottas and team-mate Sergio Perez have suffered from numerous reliability failures across Cadillac's maiden F1 campaign, albeit they have been far less dangerous, with both drivers able to either pull into the pit garage to retire or stop on track.

Pointing to the severity of this issue in the same debrief, however, Budkowski said: “Everyone is relieved that Valtteri is OK after the incident on lap 46. We will fully investigate the cause of this failure and ensure such accidents do not happen again."
Perez racks up 300 F1 races with positive showing
On the other side of the garage, Perez put on a promising display for the team in front of his home crowd as he notched up his 300th race start in F1.

The Mexican had made his way up to 13th in the opening stages on merit and was able to hold off those behind him, though a slow pitstop and a later pitlane speeding penalty - attributed to a software issue - ultimately derailed what had been a strong showing.
“Taking the positives, it was our most competitive weekend in terms of relative pace and very encouraging to see both drivers fighting in the pack," insisted Budkowski.
Dan Towriss, Cadillac Racing, Marcin Budkowski, Cadillac Racing

"They both had great starts, especially Checo, who had phenomenal first laps after both starts and was running up into P13 at one stage. We had some equipment issues in both pitstops which cost both drivers time and positions on track.
“Congratulations to Checo on his historic 300th Grand Prix start - it has been such a memorable week for him and the whole team at his home race."

items.originalTitle: How Mercedes can win the 2026 F1 constructors' championship at the Brazilian GP
detailZh: 梅赛德斯如何在巴西大奖赛赢得2026年F1车队冠军
梅赛德斯可能在本周的巴西大奖赛中赢得2026年F1车队冠军
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说。来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯。
梅赛德斯有机会在本周末的巴西大奖赛中赢得2026年F1车队冠军，在基米·安东内利在墨西哥夺冠一周后。
即将进入圣保罗站的比赛周末，梅赛德斯以126分的优势领先第二名的法拉利。
梅赛德斯如何在巴西赢得2026年F1车队 constructors' championship？
梅赛德斯需要在伊达尔戈斯赛道至少以3分领先法拉利，以确保冠军，因为在这周末之后将只有129分可用。
梅赛德斯如何在巴西肯定赢得冠军：
如果两辆梅赛德斯赛车都未能获得积分，那么比赛将在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上继续。
在巴西大奖赛之后，梅赛德斯将在拉斯维加斯、卡塔尔和阿布扎比还有三次机会来确保冠军。
“锦标赛越来越近了，但我们的心态并没有改变。思考结果并不能帮助我们实现它，”梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫在墨西哥大奖赛之前表示。
“我们将保持纪律，对待每一节练习与排位都认真对待，专注于做好基础工作。”
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
2026年一级方程式车队锦标赛排名
安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了他的首个锦标赛冠军，但争夺第二名的竞争仍在继续。
阿维德·林德布拉德，小红牛车队 - 38分
费尔南多·阿隆索，阿斯顿·马丁 - 7分
detailEn: How Mercedes can win the 2026 F1 constructors' championship at the Brazilian GP
Mercedes could clinch the 2026 Formula 1 constructors' championship at the Brazilian Grand Prix
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes has the opportunity to claim the Formula 1 constructors' championship at this weekend's Brazilian Grand Prix, one week after Kimi Antonelli clinched the drivers' title in Mexico.
Heading into the race weekend in Sao Paulo, Mercedes leads the standings by 126 points over second-placed Ferrari.
How can Mercedes win the 2026 F1 constructors' championship in Brazil?
Mercedes needs to outscore Ferrari by at least three points at Interlagos to secure the title as only 129 points will be available after this coming weekend.
How Mercedes can definitely claim the title in Brazil:
If both Mercedes cars miss the points, the fight will continue at the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
After the Brazilian Grand Prix, Mercedes will have three more opportunities to secure the championship in Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi.
"The championships are moving closer, but our mindset does not change. Thinking about the outcome won’t help us achieve it," Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff said ahead of the Mexican Grand Prix.
"We will stay disciplined, take each session as it comes, and concentrate on doing the fundamentals well."
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
2026 F1 constructors' championship standings
Antonelli secured his maiden championship at the Mexican Grand Prix, but the fight for second continues.
Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls - 38 points
Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin - 7 points
